title: Predict control-plane rejection of an invalid request
intent: Checks the answer predicts the control plane rejects an invalid name/parameter and an incompatible feature combination at validation time, and shows how to correct the request.
prompt: A team submitted this Azure Managed Redis create request and expected it to succeed. Predict what the control plane does and how to fix it.

input_artifacts.name: create-request.txt
input_artifacts.content: name: 'My Cache!!' (spaces and illegal characters); features: enables a capability that is not supported with the chosen cluster policy and tier; expectation: 'the platform will accept and provision it as-is'

embedded_defects.defect: Invalid resource name is expected to provision instead of being rejected by validation.
Incompatible feature/cluster-policy combination is expected to be silently accepted.
